glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 金 + phonetic 童. It indicates a bell, including a bronze large bell used in rituals in ancient China.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 鐘 and 鍾, replacing the original phonetic component 童 or 重 with the simpler phonetic component 中.
note: Composite id: 钟 also writes other words; this sign is the 鐘 sense. glyph_origin is from the 鐘 page; s_page_origin is the 钟 page's own text.
